questions.q: What is the message John says they heard from him and now announce?
options: God is light, and in him is no darkness
God is love, and he sent his Son
Jesus is Lord over all creation
The kingdom of God is near

questions.q: What does John say happens if we say that we have no sin?
Why does John say he writes these things?
options: That our joy may be fulfilled
That you may not be deceived
That you may know the truth

questions.q: According to John, what cleanses us from all sin?
John says if we claim we haven't sinned, we make God what?
If we confess our sins, he is ____ to forgive us the sins.
But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have ____.
That which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and ____, concerning the Word of life.
John says anyone who claims fellowship with God while walking in darkness is lying.
John says our fellowship is with the Father and with the Holy Spirit.
Besides deceiving ourselves, what else does John say is true if we say we have no sin?
options: The truth is not in us
The light is hidden from us

questions.q: From what does John say God will cleanse us when we confess our sins?
That which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have ____.
And the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you ____.
John says the Word of life he declares was from the beginning.
If anyone sins, what does John say we have with the Father in Jesus Christ?
What does John list as the things that are in the world?
options: Lust of the flesh, lust of the eyes, pride of life

questions.q: What does John say about the one who hates his brother?
options: He doesn't know where he is going
He will be cast out of the assembly
His prayers will not be heard

questions.q: Why does John say he writes to the young men?
options: They have overcome the evil one
They know him who is from the beginning

questions.q: Who is the liar but he who denies that ____?
I write a new commandment to you, because the darkness is passing away and ____.
wrong: the day of the Lord draws near

questions.q: You have ____ from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

items: Keeping his commandments shows we know him
Claiming to be in the light while hating a brother

questions.q: John says those who went out from them never truly belonged to them.
John says Jesus is the atoning sacrifice for our sins only, and not for the whole world.
Who does John say remains forever?
How ought someone who says he remains in him to walk?
options: In the fear of the Lord

questions.q: What does John say the one who confesses the Son also has?
What is the promise that he promised us?
He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no ____ in him.
Remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and ____ before him at his coming.
John says he writes to the readers because they don't know the truth.
Because of the Father's great love, what does John say we should be called?
Whom does John give as an example of one who was of the evil one?
How does John say we know love?
options: He laid down his life for us

questions.q: Why does John say we will be like him when he is revealed?
options: We will see him just as he is
We will be raised from the dead
We will be free from the world

questions.q: Whoever hates his brother is ____, and no such person has eternal life remaining in him.
To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might ____.
questions.answer: destroy the works of the devil
wrong: take away the sin of the world

questions.q: Because if our heart condemns us, God is ____, and knows all things.

items: Everyone with this hope purifies himself
Don't be surprised if the world hates you
Let's not love in word only

questions.q: John says we know we have passed out of death into life because we love the brothers.
John says we know God remains in us by the commandments he gave us.
Instead of loving in word or with the tongue only, how should we love?
Why does the world not know us, according to John?
What shows that God's love does not remain in someone who has the world's goods?
options: He closes his heart against a brother in need
He gives his goods to the temple
He keeps his goods for his family
He spends his goods on pleasure

questions.q: Why does John say whoever is born of God doesn't commit sin?
This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and ____.
Whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are ____.
John says whoever sins has truly seen him and knows him.
What does John tell believers to do with the spirits?
options: Test them to see whether they are of God
Cast them out in Jesus' name

questions.q: According to John, what casts out fear?
What mark does John give of every spirit that is of God?
options: It confesses Jesus Christ came in the flesh
It is heard by the world

questions.q: Why does John say the little children have overcome the false prophets?
options: He who is in them is greater
They have kept all his commandments
The world no longer listens to them

questions.q: He who doesn't love doesn't know God, for ____.
In this is love, not that we loved God, but that ____.
If a man says, "I love God," and hates his brother, ____.

items: Many false prophets have gone out
They are of the world, and the world hears them
No one has seen God at any time
We love him because he first loved us

questions.q: John says God sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
John testifies that the Father has sent the Son as the judge of the world.
In John's appeal to love one another, what reason does he give?
How do we know that we remain in him and he in us?
options: He has given us of his Spirit

questions.q: Why may we have boldness in the day of judgment?
options: As he is, even so we are in this world

questions.q: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, ____, and he in God.
If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love ____.
John says the spirit of the Antichrist is already in the world.
John says he who is not of God listens to the apostles.
What does John say is the victory that has overcome the world?
Who are the three that testify, according to John?
options: The Spirit, the water, and the blood
The Father, the Son, and the Spirit
The prophets, the apostles, and the church
The water, the word, and the cross

questions.q: How does John describe God's commandments?
What does John say about the whole world?
options: It lies in the power of the evil one
It is passing away with its lusts
It will be judged by fire

questions.q: Little children, ____.
The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and ____.
questions.answer: this life is in his Son
wrong: we will see him face to face

questions.q: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything ____, he listens to us.

items: Whoever loves the Father loves his child
Who overcomes the world but the one who believes
If we receive the witness of men

questions.q: John says he wrote these things so believers may know that they have eternal life.
John tells believers to make a request for a brother whose sin leads to death.
Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been what?
Whose witness does John say is greater than the witness of men?
What does the evil one not do to the one born of God?
What has the Son of God given us, according to John?
options: An understanding, that we know him who is true
A kingdom that cannot be shaken
A new law written on stone

questions.q: It is the Spirit who testifies, because ____.
He who doesn't believe God has ____, because he has not believed in the testimony.
John says the one who doesn't have God's Son still has the life.
